turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.

I can help you start a tattoo booking. A colleague will take it from there. To pass on the details, please tell me: 1) the idea or design you have in mind, 2) the approximate size, 3) where on the body you want it, and 4) when you are available.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you. I have passed your tattoo request to a colleague: a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of your left forearm, available weekday evenings. A colleague will take over and get back to you. I cannot give a price or a date for the tattoo.

input.summary: Tattoo booking request. Design: small paper boat. Size: about 8 cm wide. Placement: outside of left forearm. Availability: weekday evenings. No price or date given. Customer not verified (no order involved).
